changelog: 🚀 JIN v2.2.3: 6-Agent CLI Suite (OpenCode, DeepSeek, Codex, OpenRouter) & 100% Real Autonomous Mobile-Harness Engine.

🤖 6 Dedicated AI Coding CLI Agents: Native integration for OpenCode AI Terminal CLI (opencode-ai), DeepSeek Harness (dsh), OpenAI Codex CLI, OpenRouter Universal CLI, Anthropic Claude Code, and Google Antigravity CLI.

⚡ 100% Real Mobile-Harness Autonomous Engine: Completely overhauled JinAutonomousEngine to perform real multi-turn LLM tool execution (read/write/exec/list), live DeepSeek R1 reasoning streaming, and interactive Git diff tracking.
🌐 OpenCode Zen Multi-Model Gateway: Direct access to free-tier and premium frontier coding models (opencode-zen-coder, deepseek-v4-flash, deepseek-r1) with seamless fallback chains.
🛡️ Crash-Proof Runtime Downloader: Complete protection against native linkage errors with Throwable recovery, multi-mirror failovers, and Termux CLI launchers.
🎨 Unified 6-Agent Picker: Horizontally scrollable chip selector in Jin Fusion and Harness Studio with accent branding.
🛡️ 100% Attribution: Fully developed and authored by Samir Ahmmed (https://github.com/samir-ahmmed-tech/jin).
